description: Requests attempted during the slice that the CLOSED six-primitive catalog cannot express. Each one must end in an explicit refusal (no primitive, or no field to bind) - never in an invented binding. This file is the deliverable 'inexpressible list' of the catalog-coverage table.

requests.request: show the whole building as a coloured floor plan of every zone
requests.note: The catalog has no building-geometry primitive; ZoneHighlight is schematic and takes one zone and one series.

requests.request: compare run_ashrae140_case1 and run_humid_latent_case3 side by side
requests.note: No cross-run primitive exists, and a run other than the bound one is refused.

requests.intent: scatter plot of one field against another
requests.request: plot zone1 relative humidity against zone1 latent load as a scatter
requests.note: The catalog has no scatter / x-y primitive; only TimeSeriesChart (one series vs the sample index).

requests.intent: animated view of the solver converging
requests.request: animate the solver state while it is running
requests.note: Live / mid-run state is out of scope for a read-only lens on finished runs.

requests.intent: change an input and re-run the model
requests.request: set the heating setpoint to 22 degC and re-run the simulation
requests.note: Write path and solver execution are out of scope for this slice.

requests.intent: a request with no field in it at all
requests.note: Nothing field-like and no recognised primitive phrase: the lens refuses instead of guessing.
